name: How far in advance should I order materials for a whole-house remodel?

mainEntity.name: Which materials need early ordering so the project does not stall?
mainEntity.text: Which materials need early ordering so the project does not stall?

acceptedAnswer.text: Material timing is critical in a whole-house remodel because some items have long lead times and cannot be rushed. Cabinetry, windows, specialty tile, appliances, plumbing fixtures, custom doors, and stone are common items that should be selected and ordered early. If these materials arrive late, the project may stall even if labor is ready to move forward. The best time to order depends on the schedule, but many large projects require selections before demolition is complete. That allows the contractor to coordinate installation windows and avoid idle time. Homeowners should ask for a procurement calendar so they know which decisions must be made first. Late selections often create pressure and increase the chance of compromise on style or quality. Ordering early gives the team more flexibility and helps protect the schedule, especially when custom products are involved.
